name: Inglewood Teen Center
what_you_do: Get tutoring, college prep, leadership workshops and job help after school. In Fit For Gold, you can tutor or mentor young kids for paid work experience and high school credit.
who_can_apply: You must be 13 to 17. The center is for teens in Inglewood, Hawthorne, Lawndale and El Segundo.
pay_detail: Center services are at no cost. Fit For Gold offers paid work experience. The rate is not stated.
deadline_text: No deadline is listed. The center has set weekly hours.
how_to_apply: Call (310) 680-3702 or visit 101 W. Manchester Blvd. (lower level), Inglewood. The pages do not list sign-up steps.
notes: Ask how to get a Fit For Gold spot, since the pages do not say how many there are. One page lists the phone as (310) 680-3701, so try that if the first number does not work.
